title: API Security and Spring Review
description: Session cookies versus JWTs, password hashing, issuing and checking a JWT, role-protected endpoints, a dev profile that keeps endpoints open for front-end work, common API security risks from the OWASP API Security Top 10 (the FT7 project brief), and the Spring review, followed by the module's required Standard coding lab.
